compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: unit test asserts source+fallback for each of 11 common fields (pr_number→null outside CI; commit_sha→HEAD when CI var absent; cycle→1 default; language→auto-detect; remaining 7 fixed/config-derived)
- dd-8 (resolver-layer co-ownership): _resolve_client_id() raises ValueError on empty input

## Implementation Notes

Create `tests/scripts/test_telemetry_emit_resolvers.py` importing each `_resolve_<field>()` function from `plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/telemetry_emit.py`. Tests MUST fail with ImportError at RED commit (module doesn't exist yet — this is the canonical RED mechanism; do NOT use @pytest.mark.xfail).

11 resolvers × 2 tests each (primary source + fallback):
1. `_resolve_pr_number()` — CI env (GITHUB_PR_NUMBER) → int; outside CI → None
2. `_resolve_commit_sha()` — CI env (GITHUB_SHA) → str; absent → `git rev-parse HEAD`
3. `_resolve_cycle()` — explicit arg → int; missing → 1
4. `_resolve_language()` — explicit arg → str; missing → auto-detect heuristic
5. `_resolve_client_id()` — config → str (non-empty); empty/missing → raises ValueError
6. `_resolve_workflow()` — config → str
7. `_resolve_skill()` — config → str
8. `_resolve_event_type()` — required arg → str; must be one of 5 canonical values (review_finding, resolver_outcome, arbiter_ruling, tool_finding, review_cycle) else raises
9. `_resolve_repo_slug()` — env (GITHUB_REPOSITORY) → str; absent → derived from git remote
10. `_resolve_branch()` — env (GITHUB_REF_NAME) → str; absent → `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`
11. `_resolve_timestamp()` — ISO-8601 UTC, monotonic

Additional behavioral assertions:
- `_resolve_schema_version()` returns numeric integer 1 (not string "1")
- `_resolve_client_id()` raises ValueError on empty/missing — pytest.raises(ValueError) wrapper

Use `monkeypatch` for env isolation. Mock only at the env/file-system boundary — never stub sibling `_resolve_<field>()` functions (behavioral-testing-standard Rule 3).

Python pinning: project requires Python ≥3.11 per pyproject.toml; use only stdlib + pytest's built-in monkeypatch fixture (no pytest-mock, no pytest-httpserver).

Add `.test-index` RED marker entry (source-side format, no space before bracket):
```
plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/telemetry_emit.py:[test_resolve_pr_number_from_ci_env] tests/scripts/test_telemetry_emit_resolvers.py
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Test file exists at expected path
  Verify: test -f tests/scripts/test_telemetry_emit_resolvers.py
- [ ] Test file contains ≥ 22 test functions (one per field × primary+fallback)
  Verify: grep -c '^def test_' tests/scripts/test_telemetry_emit_resolvers.py | awk '{exit ($1 < 22)}'
- [ ] Pre-impl run fails with ImportError (RED state — canonical mechanism)
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_telemetry_emit_resolvers.py 2>&1 | grep -qE 'ImportError|ModuleNotFoundError' && python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_telemetry_emit_resolvers.py; test $? -ne 0
- [ ] No @pytest.mark.xfail decorators (canonical RED uses ImportError, not xfail)
  Verify: ! grep -q '@pytest.mark.xfail' tests/scripts/test_telemetry_emit_resolvers.py
- [ ] schema_version type assertion present (asserts int, not str)
  Verify: grep -qE 'isinstance\(.*schema_version.*int\)|assert.*schema_version.*== 1\b' tests/scripts/test_telemetry_emit_resolvers.py
- [ ] No new test dependencies beyond pytest stdlib + monkeypatch
  Verify: ! grep -qE 'pytest_mock|pytest_httpserver|httpx|requests' tests/scripts/test_telemetry_emit_resolvers.py
- [ ] .test-index has RED marker entry for the new test file (source-side format)
  Verify: grep -qE 'plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/telemetry_emit\.py:\[' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Escalation Policy
Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 1/5, CRITICAL): Reconcile resolver list with canonical schema. Schema (telemetry-event-schema.md) defines 11 common fields: schema_version, event_id, event_type, client_id, tool_id, tool_version, timestamp, pr_number, commit_sha, cycle, language. Task description previously included non-schema fields (workflow, skill, repo_slug, branch). CORRECTED resolver list: _resolve_schema_version, _resolve_event_id (UUIDv4), _resolve_event_type, _resolve_client_id, _resolve_tool_id, _resolve_tool_version, _resolve_timestamp, _resolve_pr_number, _resolve_commit_sha, _resolve_cycle, _resolve_language. Drop workflow/skill/repo_slug/branch. Optional fields (pr_number, commit_sha, cycle, language) when unavailable MUST be omitted from envelope per schema line 32 — NOT emitted as null.
